summaries.Romania: Romania faces a dual crisis: nuclear cooling challenges at Cernavodă temporarily resolved through emergency water management, while misinformation on TikTok about 'ambulances stealing children' led to violent attacks on emergency services. Critical infrastructure vulnerabilities and disinformation threats dominate the week's concerns.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare AI adoption accelerates with over 90% of health systems deploying AI tools, though governance remains inconsistent, while GLP-1 drugs reshape chronic disease management and insurance profitability rebounds. The sector navigates unprecedented technological change alongside traditional cost and access challenges.
summaries.Tech: Apple's ecosystem dominates near-term headlines with iPhone 18 preparations and M-series chip acceleration, while broader tech faces climate scrutiny over data center power demands and AI governance gaps. The industry pivots between consumer innovation and sustainability accountability.

items.title: Here’s why Apple is skipping its M6 Pro and M6 Max chips to accelerate M7 launch
items.snippet: According to reports from Bloomberg, Apple will be skipping its M6 Pro, M6 Max, and M6 Ultra chips to accelerate development of the M7 chip. That means the only chip to be released from the M6 family will be the base M6. Here’s why.
items.line: Apple skips M6 Pro/Max entirely to accelerate M7 chip launch, signaling aggressive performance competition with Intel and consolidation strategy.

items.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
items.snippet: As part of a planned Texas data center, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could reportedly become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States.
items.line: Amazon's planned Texas data center power plant could become America's single largest climate polluter, raising enterprise tech environmental accountability.
